01

Student affairs

From enrollment to a new academic year: bring student records, attendance and academic activity together for daily follow-up.

Explore details
  • Add or import students from Excel; export records, student cards and enrollment certificates.
  • Class attendance, student transfers and progression to corresponding classes in a new year.
  • Timetables prevent teacher clashes, with generated drafts for administrative review.
  • Subjects, grades, activities, and assignments with automatic or manual marking.
  • Online lesson links, targeted announcements and pickup requests.
  • Automatic scheduling produces a draft, not a guaranteed complete timetable. Assignment grades are separate from the academic record.
02

Fees & collections

See what is due and what has been paid, with organized fee plans, discounts and reminders.

Explore details
  • Individual or group fee plans and discounts within the selected branch.
  • Record payments, receipts and invoices.
  • Reconcile prior-year balances and remind parents of outstanding amounts.
03

Accounting

Connect daily transactions to your financial picture, from journal entries to statements and reports.

Explore details
  • Chart of accounts and automatic entries from payments, expenses and payroll.
  • Balanced manual entries and budget-to-actual comparisons.
  • Trial balance, balance sheet and income statement.
04

Staff & payroll

Organize staff records, teacher attendance and payroll with clear records for reviewing entitlements.

Explore details
  • Teacher and staff records with daily teacher attendance.
  • Calculate payroll from attendance records and issue payment vouchers.
  • GOSI contribution amount summaries; no direct integration or automatic payment.
05

School transport

Manage buses, routes and student subscriptions, and prepare passenger lists for each route.

Explore details
  • Buses, routes, stops and subscriptions within vehicle capacity.
  • PDF and Excel passenger lists, with transport charges in fee plans.
  • GPS tracking and a driver app are not included.
06

School services

From uniforms and books to activities: organize service subscriptions and review them before saving.

Explore details
  • Individual or group subscriptions for uniforms, books, cafeteria, activities and clubs.
  • Preview before saving and PDF/Excel lists for each service.
  • Inventory management and cafeteria point of sale are not included.
07

Reports & insights

Move from individual records to the bigger picture with indicators, charts and exportable reports.

Explore details
  • Revenue, expenses, outstanding fees, payroll and financial statements.
  • Advanced student search with exportable results.
  • Dashboard indicators and charts, Excel/PDF exports and printing.
08

Administration

Give each role the right tools and organize branches, academic years and settings in one environment.

Explore details
  • View each branch’s lists and reports separately, with school-wide accounting.
  • Customizable roles and permissions, with an activity log.
  • New academic year setup and subscription/usage visibility.
  • Dark mode and menus/main headings in Arabic, English, French and German.

Three portals.
A closer connection for every user.

The right information for each person, within their role and permissions.

Parent portal

Follow your children from one place.

  • Grades, activities, assignments and online lessons.
  • Outstanding fees, payments, invoices, transport and services.
  • Announcements, conversations with administration and pickup requests.

Teacher portal

Tools scoped to the teacher’s classes and subjects.

  • Timetables and starting/ending online lessons.
  • Grade entry, assignments, tests and marking.
  • Announcements, administration conversations and payroll history.

Student portal

A clearer path for learning and follow-up.

  • Grades, academic records, activities and fee status.
  • Online lessons, assignments, tests and announcements.
  • Account registration and recovery by verification code if enabled by the school.

Extend the experience.
With the connections you need.

Optional integrations use the school’s own accounts and settings, with third-party charges paid by the school.

Optional

WhatsApp Business

Receipts, fee/absence reminders, announcements and verification codes using the school’s own account and Meta-approved templates.

Optional

Mobile notifications

The parent portal as a PWA, with notifications over a secure connection. On iPhone, add it to the home screen; iOS 16.4 or later is required.

Optional

Online payments

Payments from the parent portal through Moyasar or PayTabs, using the school’s merchant account and credentials.

Optional

Email

Parent reminders through the school-configured SMTP email server.

E-invoicing and ZATCA status

The integration is not ready for production use. It has not been tested in ZATCA’s environment or certified by ZATCA, and is not presented as an available capability. Standard business-to-business tax invoices are not currently supported.

Clearer access.
Better preparation for protecting your work.

Access suited to each role

Customizable permissions; teachers access their assigned classes and subjects.

Backups include uploaded files

Automatic daily backups and safety copies before restoration and database upgrades.

Source-verified updates

Digitally signed updates, with integrity verification before installation.

Account and backup protection details

Passwords are stored as one-way hashes and integration credentials are encrypted, with login rate limits and limited-use verification codes. Backup files themselves are not encrypted; store them securely and test restoration.

Getting started

Installation & setup guide

Follow the setup steps from download to first launch on your school computer.

Download installation guide (README) ↓
Before you begin
  • Use a Windows 10 or 11 computer as the school server. Keep it running during school hours, preferably connected to power and the school network.
  • The installation itself does not require an administrator account. The optional firewall and sleep settings request administrator approval once.
  • Keep a copy of the installer and download it only through the official link on this website.
1) Download

Download SchoolSystemSetup.exe using the download button. To check that it matches the published file, compare its SHA-256 hash with the hash in the Download verification section for the same release. Open PowerShell and run:

(Get-FileHash "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\SchoolSystemSetup.exe" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
2) Windows launch notice

Windows may display a notice because the current installer is not signed with an Authenticode certificate. Check the download source, release version and published SHA-256 hash before deciding to run it. A matching hash confirms file consistency; it does not replace a security scan or your school's security policies. Contact support before continuing if you are unsure.

3) Installation options

After selecting the installer language, you will see additional tasks. On the server computer that other devices will connect to, select:

  • A desktop shortcut, if wanted.
  • Start the program automatically when signing in to Windows: recommended for the server.
  • Allow the program through Windows Firewall on private networks only: requires administrator approval. Other computers and phones cannot connect without the required firewall access.
  • Prevent sleep while connected to power: unchecked by default and recommended for the server; requires administrator approval. Uninstalling restores the original power plan.

These server options are not needed for an individual trial on one computer.

4) First launch
  1. Read the software agreement through the terms link, select the acceptance checkbox and continue.
  2. On the first-run setup page, create the system administrator account and choose a strong password. Store it securely; it cannot be recovered through this website.
  3. The program includes a 14-day trial with all features. After purchase, enter the license key on the Licensing page.
5) Connect from a phone or another computer
  • Connect the device to the same school network, by Wi-Fi or cable.
  • At startup, the program displays the server address in the form http://server-address:5000. Open that address in the other device's browser.
  • On iPhone, open the parent portal in Safari, then choose Share and Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the portal directly in the browser.
  • Mobile notifications require a secure HTTPS address configured by the school; they are not available over the ordinary local HTTP address. On iPhone and iPad, Web Push requires iOS or iPadOS 16.4 or later and a web app added to the Home Screen.
6) Backups
  • After important work, open Settings, then Backup. Create and download a backup, and keep it on an external drive or USB drive.
  • Backups are not encrypted. Store them securely and do not send them through untrusted channels.
  • Installation-specific encryption keys are deliberately excluded from backups. When restoring on a new computer, you may need to re-enter some external service keys, such as WhatsApp or payment service keys.
7) Updates

Open Check for updates in the dashboard. If a newer version is available, the program downloads it after your approval and checks the update signature and hash before installation. Create a backup before every update.

8) Uninstall

Use Windows Settings, then Apps. Create a backup first, because uninstalling may remove the program's local data.

9) Help

Use the support channels listed on this website. Include the program version from About and a description of the issue. Do not send passwords or real student data.

Questions to help you decide

How can the system help my school?

It brings student records, fees, attendance, timetables and reports together, with role-based access and dedicated portals for administrators, teachers and parents.

Where does it run and where is the data stored?

It is installed on a Windows computer at your school and accessed through a browser. Data stays on the host computer; external access can be configured for portals.

Can I try it before deciding?

Yes. A 14-day free trial lets you explore available features and evaluate suitability for your school. Ask us to help identify the most relevant workflows to try.

How do I get a tailored quote?

Tell us your student and branch counts and required features. We will review your needs and prepare a clear proposal with the appropriate scope.

Is mobile access available?

The parent portal can be added to a mobile home screen as a progressive web app. A native mobile app is not currently available.
